description: Application for a (Section 96a) non-material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/24/00184, Dated 23/01/2025  (for the redevelopment of the site involving demolition of all existing buildings on site excluding main hospital building, south wing and sanitation tower to provide 274 new homes and flexible commercial and community floorspace (Use Class E(b) / F2(b)) within a converted and extended hospital building and five new buildings ranging from five (5) to nine (9) storey in height).The non-material amendment is to introduce and formalise a sequence of phases to the development, involving Phases 0 (enabling/demolition), 1 (Blocks A and B) and 2 (remaining development Blocks C, D,E and F) alongside temporary works and other minor landscape adjustments to facilitate the phasing approach.
site_name: Former London Chest Hospital, Bonner Road, London, E2 9JX
